messages.subject: workflowr 1.6.2
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I submitted workflowr 1.6.2 to CRAN today. It includes minor improvements, updated documentation, and bug fixes.

https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/releases/tag/v1.6.2

Many thanks to the contributors that helped with this latest release: James Lamb, Anh Tran, Sydney Purdue, and Jim Hester

Release notes:

This patch release of workflowr includes minor improvements, updated documentation, and bug fixes. Users are encouraged to upgrade workflowr so that it is compatible with the next release of fs <https://github.com/r-lib/fs> (>1.4.1).

Minor improvements
Make the HTTP calls by wflow_use_github() to the GitHub API more resilient to transient network issues by automatically retrying HTTP calls more than once (@jameslamb <https://github.com/jameslamb>, #199 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/199>, #201 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/201>)
Enhance the RStudio Project Template to include more arguments from wflow_start() (@trannhatanh89 <https://github.com/trannhatanh89>, #193 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/193>, #200 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/200>)
Throw error early if user sets overwrite = TRUE to wflow_start() but existing = FALSE, since it isn't possible to overwrite non-existent files (@skpurdue <https://github.com/skpurdue>, #194 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/194>, #202 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/202>, idea from @pcarbo <https://github.com/pcarbo>)
Updated documentation
Update FAQ entry on external images to note that the website directory for GitLab Pages is public/, not docs/ (idea from @ryurko <https://github.com/ryurko>)
Bug fixes
Send warning if Python plots created using outdated version of reticulate (<1.15) (bug report from @lazappi <https://github.com/lazappi>, #181 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/issues/181>)
Make workflowr compatible with fs version 1.4.1.9000+ (@jimhester <https://github.com/jimhester>, #204 <https://github.com/jdblischak/workflowr/pull/204>)
Set minimum version requirement for dependency rprojroot to 1.2
Skip test of error handling of deleted working directory on Solaris
